gate.text: Every document in this set is about artificial intelligence, so none of their provisions apply to technology that does not use AI. This tool has no results for it.
gate.note: The documents cite other GTA policies that are not in this set, including PM-04-001 and PS-08-005 (unresolved references UR02, UR03). This tool does not describe them.
cites: Definition of 'Artificial Intelligence': Generative AI Responsible Use (SS-25-001), Terms and Definitions, p.1: “machine-based system that can, for a given set of human-defined objectives, make predictions, recommendations or decisions influencing real or virtual environments.”

notes.text: The two 2025 documents say they cover generative AI: SS-25-001 says “State government employees shall follow this standard when using commercial GenAI solutions” and GS-25-001 says “These guidelines apply to all forms of generative AI”. This result shows only provisions from the five documents that cover AI in general, plus one GS-25-001 provision that names “other automated decision-making systems”. Whether other provisions in the 2025 documents reach non-generative AI is open question OQ27. None of the seven documents mentions AI agents (OQ28). The documents define generative AI as “tools or systems used to create models that can generate new and original content, such as images, music, or text, based on patterns and examples from existing data”; if your agent creates content like that, choose Generative AI instead.

text: What kind of AI is it?
help: SS-25-001 defines generative AI as “tools or systems used to create models that can generate new and original content, such as images, music, or text, based on patterns and examples from existing data.” SS-23-002 also defines machine learning and deep learning. None of the documents mentions AI agents; they are grouped with “Other AI”, but if an agent creates new content, choose Generative AI. If you are asking about something with no AI in it, such as an ordinary cloud application, choose “It does not use AI”.

options.label: Generative AI that writes, summarizes, or creates images, audio or video (for example ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude or Copilot)
